note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it. Guides are written in my own words for this entry and cite their sources beside each trophy; where launch-era guides still mark a trophy unknown, the guide says so instead of inventing a method.

roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters (60-80 hours, PowerPyx). There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay, so just play. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — the game has 15 manual slots. During Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude); it is the only trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you go: both count toward the 100% checklist later.
roadmap.title: Play the story — and catch the one missable meditation

roadmap.text: Finish the final mission for each optional quest giver: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason only) and Bret (Jason only), plus 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Every one of these stays available after the story in free-roam, so none of them can be missed — work through them whenever their icons appear.
roadmap.title: Side-character questlines

roadmap.text: Rob bank vaults (8 for 100%), armored trucks, jewelry stores and one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Launder $250,000 of marked bills through a fence, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so the money trophies fund themselves.
roadmap.title: Robberies, gangs and money

roadmap.text: Work the long counters: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 race wins, 50 of the 80 challenges, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles discovered, all 18 meditation spots and the full map unfogged. Pick the easiest categories first — under-the-bridge stunts are the quickest, per PowerPyx.
roadmap.title: Activities, stunts and collectibles

roadmap.text: After the story, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — roughly 60% of everything, with most side quests not required and only 70 of 80 challenges needed. Finish it for A Long Road (gold), mop up anything left, and Vice Got a Price! (platinum) pops.
roadmap.title: 100% checklist, then the platinum

title: Leonida Platinum — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC: all 55 trophies are single-player and offline. Because A Long Road (100% completion) is the last big gate, the platinum effectively arrives right after that gold. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Just play the opening mission through to its end and it pops. This is the first trophy most players will earn, and it needs no side content at all.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?', which is how the chapter boundary falls. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that may not wait: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Chapter 2 is also where you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia (after the mission Coffee Break) — from then on, partner trophies like Hot Together and Retail Therapy become possible.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Chapter 3 is where several questlines open — Andy's, Randy's (and the Key Cloner), Tyrone's and the jewelry jobs that unlock the Snap Gun — so it is worth doing the optional missions as they appear.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Chapter 4 is where the big bank-vault robberies open (the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'), which also sets up Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the game's final mission, the last mission of Chapter 5. After it, the game returns you to free-roam in Leonida and the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Nothing in the story is missable except possibly the Chapter 1 meditation, so reaching this trophy means the platinum run is still fully open.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed — just follow the main story. The mission's name is the trophy's whole requirement, so there is no extra step and no collectible attached to it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed — just follow the main story. Like the other mission trophies, it pops on completion with nothing extra to collect or do.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed — just follow the main story. PowerPyx lists it among the unmissable mission trophies that pop as the five chapters play out.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed — just follow the main story. No side quest, collectible or choice feeds into it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It cannot be missed. The airport is worth remembering, though: the standalone trophy Catch Me If You Can is earned there later by stealing a docked passenger plane.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed — just follow the main story into the final chapter. After this mission the story is nearly done, and free-roam cleanup begins.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the last big gate before the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100%: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of everything, most side quests are not required, and only 70 of 80 challenges are needed. The parts that do demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The big numbers: any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, 300 stunts, and 15 of 18 meditations. Do optional missions as they appear and scan/study everything you pass, and most of the list fills itself in.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. The four categories are 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like. PowerPyx calls under-the-bridge flights the quickest to grind. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy. Track progress in the Progress menu under Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon). You will be introduced to most of them by the story anyway, so this usually pops on its own while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the game's 12 shooting ranges. PowerPyx links its full locations guide for all 12 ranges and 42 golds, and notes the gold medals 'aren't too difficult'. All 42 are also required for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut: work through each range until every challenge shows gold. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx). Each location has its own race, so you need a win at every one of the 14, not just 14 wins anywhere. All drone races are required for the 100% checklist too, so this folds into the cleanup stage. A drone-race win also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Each location counts once, so repeating the same easy race does not help — you need wins at 20 distinct spots. Race wins also feed Master of None (win a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race counts as one activity type). Pick the shortest circuits first and use your fastest car.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow his quests and then beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and catching fish raises your Focus level.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the 4 arcade games (called 'Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — available from Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it, so pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional storyline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton), he calls you and is marked by the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; find the underwater treasures — use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor — and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so this is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional storyline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, race against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his deliveries) — and notes more strangers are still being found. Many optional questlines do NOT count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie), so don't rely on those. Strangers stay available after the story in free-roam, and your count is visible in the trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list, and a popup appears when you enter one he wants. Deliver each car to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City); good condition pays more. Sports cars turn up most often in east Vice City around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach. This stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-quest storyline, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. First destroy the labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then Tyrone gives the second quest 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story. Note Tyrone's quests do not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do the Chapter 1 step first. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot (each counts +2 at the same location; track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). The risk: one meditation exists only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says 'You know what I'm gonna do? Meditate' — follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept' when she shows you how. PowerPyx says this first meditation raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a 'Meditation Spot' like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — but the author earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, exclusive to Jason. It is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69', retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck; there are 15 Target Decks in total and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so work through Bret's quests in order. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 collectible card set locations, so there are far more sets than the 3 you need — pick the three whose cards are closest together or easiest to reach. Cards are a pure collectible: no mission or enemy is attached to them, and they stay available after the story, so this is a clean cleanup-stage trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations. WAiNK scans are objects in the environment you scan by holding Up and then R1. PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures (plus No Flusher tags), so there are well over 100 to choose from — any 100 count. The same WAiNK app is how you scan vehicles (hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle) and check Randy's wishlist cars, so scanning becomes second nature during the story. This is a pure counter trophy with no missable element.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. For the 100% checklist you need 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. View and track challenges under Progress > Challenges (a checkmark in the bottom-right corner shows when one is done). Many complete naturally while you chase the other trophies; when you are near the end, pick the easiest remaining ones — there are 10 more challenges than the 100% checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest ones entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest this can be done is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (causing carnage does it fast), then escape the red 'heat' wanted zone on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone, not the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', since robbing large bank vaults always triggers 4-star heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time: keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, never let it drop and never reach the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs, and leave before police arrive — if you leave the first store before police show up, hit a 4th shop. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes). The fastest way, per PowerPyx: use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops automatically on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First buff your focus — eat/drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 enemies, ideally criminals at gang operations, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. PowerPyx recommends the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading straight inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). PowerPyx places them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, with the tanks standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance at a military base, so bring body armor and be ready to fight your way out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon). Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — when you approach a locked door you get the choice to kick it (triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)', which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it. Bring your partner (you cannot carry all the cash alone; hold Right to hand off a bag). After that quest, pay Yasmani — the fence unlocked in Chapter 3 — for security-van tips ($10,000 each; finish his earlier Payday Loans robberies first), which mark vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. All 8 vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, and each pays up to $205,000, so keep going past 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and all 8 large bank jobs are required for the 100% checklist anyway. To get it earlier, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (Yasmani is unlocked as a fence in Chapter 3). Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red 'heat' radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest method, per PowerPyx, is to fly a plane over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible — its guide links a dedicated unfogging route with the best plane to use. This is pure exploration with no enemies or collectibles attached, and it also reveals the icons you need for almost every other trophy, so doing it early pays off twice.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them (many are also marked automatically from story progress). You only need 1 per gang for this trophy, but all 39 are required for the 100% checklist, so it pops on the way. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, in the bottom-right corner.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy: one specific drink, at one specific bar, with the view. PowerPyx's guide shows the bar's location with screenshots, and notes the trophy pops once you drink there. It is a quick detour whenever you are in Vice City — no mission, enemy or purchase chain is attached.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it out through the window: the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the blue Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window — the pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street. Only this blue Banshee works, not any other car; it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the illegal gang operations. First buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the remaining valuables.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to 'Strength' (heart icon). Raise it by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club (filter the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon — there are many across Vice City) or work out at home after the story. Always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. Keep training both until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the game counts them, and you can see your total by clicking this trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do affects your reputation. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status PowerPyx warns against, since cops become far more aggressive. This mostly happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so it should pop while you work on the other trophies. If it is the last one left, PowerPyx's fallback is to run over civilians and cops with a car — but avoid reaching Irredeemable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Honest answer: as of the game's launch week, this trophy is still unknown. PowerPyx lists it as 'currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from Prologue)'. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests retrying something that failed once, and the Payday Loans store from the prologue is the lead the guide community is chasing. Do not grind blindly for it: check the cited PowerPyx guide for updates once players confirm the trigger, and keep a manual save from the prologue area if you still have one. This entry will not invent a method for a trophy nobody has confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Per PowerPyx: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so be patient and come solo.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a motorcycle or push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are dense enough to chain 10 kicks inside a minute. This is a pure stunt trophy: no mission, no setup beyond a bike and a crowd. Expect a wanted level — that is fine, just keep kicking until the counter hits 10 and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through a fence — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'. This comes naturally while you do all the robberies for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest route, per PowerPyx, is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation (24 stores), car mods (14 mod shops), and tattoos (11 studios) — with 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 15 electronics stores and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays also counting. There is no single purchase that covers it, so just keep buying gear as you play; between weapons, mods and outfits this pops well before the end of a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to fund them, especially the higher-value robberies unlocked in Chapters 3-4. Buying garages also adds parking spots, which you need for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click 'Respray' and then 'Register'. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
